packs.name: Havenwild Worldgen Full Terrain Tileset
packs.notes: Broad 4096-slot terrain-only atlas for worldgen coverage exploration. Useful as a source/reference baseline, but likely too large to maintain as the canonical runtime tileset.

packs.name: Havenwild Compact Plus-Mask Tileset
packs.notes: Compact plus-mask autotile experiment. Suitable as a road/path/connector reference, but later corner-mask shoreline work supersedes it for coast and bank transitions.

packs.name: Havenwild Corner-Mask Tileset
packs.notes: Corner-mask / marching-squares shoreline pack that fixes the plus-mask shoreline artifacts from v002. Strong candidate reference for coast, riverbank, lake, cave, and cliff transition logic.

packs.name: Havenwild Depth Shore Profiles
packs.notes: Production-style shoreline/depth profile follow-up to v003. Best current source pack for richer water depth bands, shore profile selection, and corner-mask terrain edge behavior.
